title: [Master Data Management] Fix usage telemetry and make it emit max once per day
summary: Master Data Management usage telemetry is restored with a frequency limit to emit at most once per day, distinguishing cross-environment and same-environment synchronizations.
key_points: Usage telemetry reintroduced after being erroneously removed from release branches
Telemetry now emits at most once per day instead of with every sync
Cross-environment sync distinguished from same-environment sync with separate tags
Tag 0000JIR restored for the same tracking purpose as in NAV repo
Minimal risk change that restores removed functionality with rate limiting
quote: Reintroduce usage, but make it not emit with every synch. Make it emit max once per day.
